The App

A role-based automotive management system that enables employees and administrators to manage vehicle operations, documents, and performance data in real time. The system is designed for scalability, security, and operational efficiency.

Secure Access Control

Biometric authentication combined with role-based permissions ensures only authorised users can access sensitive business data.

Automated Documentation

Generates and distributes professional PDF invoices and quotations instantly, reducing manual admin workload.

Operational Intelligence

Real-time performance tracking and inventory insights to support data-driven decision making.

The Problem

Antonie Motors needed a modern system to replace manual workflows in vehicle servicing, invoicing, and staff coordination. Existing processes were slow, inconsistent, and lacked real-time visibility between staff and management.

The goal was to design a connected mobile and web platform that improves communication, automates administrative tasks, and centralises all operational data into one secure system.

System Design

The mobile application communicates with Firebase Realtime Database to ensure instant synchronization between users. Offline caching was implemented to allow uninterrupted usage in low-connectivity environments.

Role-based access control separates functionality between administrators and employees, ensuring secure and structured data flow across the system.

Collaborative Dynamics

Challenges & Solutions

During development of the Antonie Motors system, several technical and architectural challenges arose that required careful system design and problem-solving.

CHALLENGE: ROLE-BASED SYSTEM COMPLEXITY
Managing multiple user roles (employee, admin, business owner) created complex access control requirements across the app.
SOLUTION
Designed and implemented a structured RBAC system that dynamically controlled feature access based on user roles, ensuring security and preventing unauthorized actions across both mobile and backend systems.
CHALLENGE: REAL-TIME DATA CONSISTENCY
Ensuring that employee performance data, leaderboards, and task updates reflected accurately and in real time across users.
SOLUTION
Leveraged Firebase real-time capabilities and optimized data structure design to ensure consistent updates across devices, including live leaderboard synchronization and task status updates.
CHALLENGE: MULTI-SYSTEM INTEGRATION
Integrating authentication, biometric login, task management, and document generation into a single seamless workflow.
SOLUTION
Implemented modular architecture separating authentication, business logic, and UI layers, allowing each system to function independently while maintaining smooth integration across the application.
